exposure: Isolated AWE vs. pelvic endometriosis-associated AWE
umbilical AWE and no surgical history
cohort: 35 women with histologically confirmed abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE)
finding: Abdominal wall endometriosis is an uncommon condition associated with long diagnostic and therapeutic delays, and its presentation differs based on the presence of concurrent pelvic endometriosis and history of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women with isolated AWE were more likely to have a history of cesarean section.
